major_cooldowns.name: Empower Rune Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend a charge before you sit at two, and press it any time you have no Killing Machine or are short on runes.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 47568 is the cast id seen in all five sampled parses; 1231100 shares the name and was not observed. Two charges, and Frostbound Will shortens the recharge by 6s per Rime consumed.

major_cooldowns.name: Pillar of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown together with your other cooldowns and on-use trinkets, and spend every Killing Machine on Obliterate while it is up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 51271 is both the cast and the self aura in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Reaper's Mark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it on the same GCD as Pillar of Frost, and never onto a target that still carries the mark.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 439843 is the cast id in all five parses; 434765 is the enemy debuff and 436304 and 439594 were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Breath of Sindragosa
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it off the GCD as Pillar of Frost goes up, and stop dumping runic power in the last few globals before it is ready.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1249658 is the cast and self aura observed in all five parses; 155166 and 1234304 share the name and were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Frostwyrm's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it right after Pillar of Frost and save the recall for the best buff overlap or the biggest cluster inside that window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 279302 is the cast id; 279303 is the enemy debuff and 1265384 is the Chosen of Frostbrood recall cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Raise Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Summon your ghoul off the GCD at the pull and again every time the cooldown returns.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 46585 is the cast id in all five parses; 52150 and 1242866 share the name and were not observed.

rule.description: Empower Rune Weapon, Pillar of Frost, Frostwyrm's Fury
rule.action: Lead with Empower Rune Weapon so you enter Pillar of Frost holding Killing Machine, then send the frostwyrm.

rule.description: Frostwyrm's Fury only inside Pillar of Frost
rule.action: Hold the frostwyrm until Pillar of Frost is up, or the cast wastes Chosen of Frostbrood.

rule.description: Breath of Sindragosa paired with Pillar of Frost
rule.action: Press Breath of Sindragosa off the GCD in the same window as Pillar of Frost rather than on its own.

rule.description: Reaper's Mark on the same GCD as Pillar of Frost
rule.action: Macro Reaper's Mark to Pillar of Frost so the Strength buff covers Wave of Souls.

rule.description: Spend every Rime proc on Howling Blast
rule.action: Cast Howling Blast as soon as Rime lights up to pull Empower Rune Weapon back faster.
Swap your Killing Machine spender from Obliterate to Frostscythe once the pack is up.

rule.description: Glacial Advance replaces Frost Strike in AoE
rule.action: Dump runic power with Glacial Advance instead of Frost Strike on a real pack, and stay on Frost Strike against a pair.
